claims.statement: The cloudflare-dns Kustomization deploys external-dns (chart v1.22.0) with the cloudflare provider, sourcing records from DNSEndpoint CRDs and gateway-httproute (gateway-name external), policy sync, proxied records, domain filter ${SECRET_DOMAIN}, and a CF_API_TOKEN from the SOPS Secret cloudflare-dns-secret with Stakater Reloader restarts.

cloudflare-tunnel runs cloudflared (image tag 2026.9.3) with `tunnel run`, credentials via TUNNEL_TOKEN from the SOPS Secret cloudflare-tunnel-secret, a config ConfigMap mounted at /etc/cloudflared/config.yaml routing ${SECRET_DOMAIN} and *.${SECRET_DOMAIN} to the Cilium Gateway service cilium-gateway-external.kube-system, http2 transport, /ready probes on port 8080, and reloader.stakater.com/auto restart on Secret change.

The DNSEndpoint `cloudflare-tunnel` publishes CNAME external.${SECRET_DOMAIN} -> 5b7a9006-79aa-4f8d-a157-fde642c738fe.cfargotunnel.com, which external-dns syncs into Cloudflare to route public traffic into the tunnel.

The tailscale operator (chart tailscale-operator v1.102.4) gets OAuth credentials from Secret tailscale-secret (valuesFrom mapping client_id/client_secret to oauth.clientId/clientSecret); that Secret is produced by an ExternalSecret pulling username/password from Bitwarden item tailscale_k8s_oauth via ClusterSecretStore bitwarden-login, and Reloader restarts the operator on change.

Tailscale provides tailnet egress and access: apiServerProxyConfig.mode 'true' enables the API server proxy, and ExternalName Services annotated with tailscale.com/tailnet-ip (e.g. prod-cluster-mosquitto -> 100.123.28.51) let in-cluster workloads reach remote tailnet hosts.

Bitwarden Connect (bitwarden-eso-provider chart v1.2.0 in namespace external-secrets) backs ESO v2.11.0 as the cluster's ExternalSecret provider: the provider authenticates to Bitwarden using Secret bitwarden-cli (keys BW_PASSWORD, BW_USERNAME, BW_HOST, SOPS-encrypted), and applications consume secrets through ClusterSecretStore bitwarden-login with remoteRef keys naming Bitwarden items.
